title.narrative: REST - Stärkung der Resilienz in den vom Erdbeben betroffenen Gebieten in Syrien und der Türkei

description.narrative: Explanation of the composition of the target groups:(1) Syria- farmers and communities of farmers; prioritize women and PWD as much as possible; both IDPs and host communities; Children and youth will be a secondary target group through the community initiatives(2) Türkiye- Syrian youth refugees mainly, limited Turkish youngsters, to ensure social cohesion; emphases on young women and PWD

Objective: Enhance socio-economic resilience in earthquake-affected areas in Syria and Türkiye through an integrated approach by ensuring food and nutrition security, strengthening market systems, youth employment, and fostering inclusive social cohesion.

Project focused on reviving the agriculture and related livelihoods in NW Syria and SE Turkey, areas impacted by the earthquake. A blend of activities among which: (1)setting up an Agro Business Center for small farmers; (2)providing capacity building for farmers and create market linkages; (3)distributing agriculture inputs and providing post harvesting and processing services; (4)setting up small business and providing vocational training, including employment support in TUR; (5)rolling out LANN+ approach and organizing nutrition community initiatives; (6) capacity building for CBOs and 1 local NGO.
